dependencies: Python standard library only; no pip install or editable installation

checks.configuration: compile all Python source/scripts without execution or bytecode writes; load all experiment TOMLs; reject unsupported candidate depth
checks.factorials: 60 Stage A conditions; 48 Stage B conditions and 144 blocks for each v1/v2/v3/v4 plan; 14,400/14,400/3,600/7,200 exact unique request slots and two-generator pairing; reject a rehashed reduced sample containing a development ID
checks.datasets: synthetic SQuAD and HotpotQA ingestion, Unicode character offsets, source/question split isolation and order independence, labels outside corpus, prepare/inspect roundtrip, corrupt saved input and invalid annotation rejection
checks.chunk_boundaries: synthetic character counter; exact contiguous source slices, bounded lengths and sentence fallback
checks.retrieval: BM25 relevant candidate before zero-score candidate; exact RRF rank contributions, duplicate suppression and conflicting identity rejection
checks.context_and_scoring: headers/separators counted, duplicate suppression, ranked stop, partial final source/context offsets, evidence lost to truncation excluded, overlapping evidence union, normalized EM/F1 and Hotpot special answers
checks.resume_integrity: exclusive writer, changed identity rejection, failed attempt preservation, consecutive retries, duplicate success rejection, chain/tail corruption refusal without repair and lock cleanup
checks.public_results: existing standalone verifier checks original hashes, 56 conditions, 448 metric rows, 1760 contrast rows and three SVGs

writes: synthetic inputs and records in auto-cleaned system temporary storage only; bytecode writes disabled
runtime_guards: reject model/viewer numerical dependencies, network connections/listeners/DNS and subprocess launches
failure_behavior: check groups run independently; named errors and exit status 1 on any failure; explicit checks survive Python -O; --json emits one schema-versioned summary

ci.permissions: contents: read; checkout credentials not persisted

limits: Operational smoke coverage, not the ignored full unittest suite.
Character-counter scenarios do not validate BGE/native tokenizer behavior or neural numerical outputs.
No model weights, corpus downloads, indexes, saved raw runs, dashboard snapshot or backend are required.
Public aggregates are checked, not raw study chains or bootstrap recomputation.
CI Python provisioning and source checkout may access the network; the Python verification command is offline.
Passing this check does not complete a fresh benchmark development gate, model rerun or full dependency/platform replication.
Frozen study manifests, previous measurements and archives remain unchanged.
